page.title: Shipping & Returns
page.intro: Authentic, high-quality supplements delivered safely to your doorstep. Everything you need to know about processing times, shipment tracking, international shipping, and how to return your order.

sections.title: Order Processing Time
items: All orders are processed within 1–3 business days.
Orders are not shipped or delivered on weekends or public holidays.
During periods of high order volume, shipments may be delayed by a few days. If your order experiences a significant delay, we will contact you by email or phone.

sections.title: Shipping Rates & Estimated Delivery Times
content: We take pride in delivering orders quickly so you can receive your supplements without unnecessary delays.
items: Shipping costs are calculated and displayed at checkout. Standard shipping is also free for eligible orders above the specified minimum amount in the local currency.
Deliveries may occasionally be delayed due to weather conditions, carrier-related issues, or peak holiday periods.

sections.title: Shipping Confirmation & Order Tracking
content: Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number. Tracking numbers become active within 24 hours, allowing you to follow your package until it is delivered.

sections.title: Trusted US Brands & Quality Assurance
content: We source products directly from leading supplement brands in the United States. Each product is stored in temperature-controlled environments before being packaged and shipped to you to preserve maximum effectiveness and freshness.

sections.title: Damaged & Lost Packages
content: Promolecules is not responsible for products that are damaged or lost during transit. However, we still want you to have a positive experience.
If your order arrives damaged, please contact the shipping carrier or our support team to file a claim.
Please keep all packaging materials and damaged items until your claim has been fully resolved.
For assistance, contact us by email at info@promolecules.com.

sections.title: Incorrect Shipping Addresses
content: Customers are responsible for providing an accurate shipping address during checkout. Promolecules will not be responsible for packages delivered to an incorrect address provided by the customer.
If a package is returned to us due to an incorrect address, the customer will be responsible for paying any additional shipping costs required to resend the order.

sections.title: International Shipping
content: We also offer international shipping. Standard shipping times (2–5 days) apply only to domestic orders. International shipments typically take 7–21 business days.
Your order may be subject to customs duties and taxes, including Value Added Tax (VAT), once it arrives in the destination country. Promolecules is not responsible for paying these charges.

sections.title: How to Request a Return
steps: Contact Us — Email info@promolecules.com with your order number and reason for the return.
Receive Approval — Once approved, we will send you a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number along with instructions on where to send your package.
Package & Ship — Carefully and securely package the unopened items and clearly write the RMA number on the outside of the package.
sections.note: Please Note: Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility (unless the return is due to our error), and shipping costs are non-refundable. We recommend using a trackable shipping service or shipping insurance, as we cannot guarantee receipt of returned items.

sections.title: Have Questions About Your Shipment?
content: If you have any questions or concerns about your order's shipping status, our customer support team will be happy to assist you.
